principle: Keep reader/answer model, memory system, embedding model, and judge model distinct in configuration, logs, cost accounting, and claims.

context.llama_cpp_metadata_override: qwen3.context_length=int:131072; required because this server build otherwise caps the per-request slot at 40960 even with YaRN flags
context.kv_cache: q8_0 on CPU via --no-kv-offload; weights GPU-offloaded; single parallel slot
context.truncation_policy: No silent truncation. Record tokenizer prompt tokens and server truncated flag per query; any truncated main-track answer is an invalid run item requiring investigation and rerun before scoring.

main_track.coverage: All compatible baseline systems and Health-Copilot adapters use this same reader artifact, runtime, generation settings, and context configuration in Main Track. System-specific memory prompts and retrieval behavior remain part of the memory system and must be hashed/logged.

upstream_parity_sanity_track.purpose: Low-cost adapter and direction sanity only; not the primary benchmark and not a performance claim against published numbers.
upstream_parity_sanity_track.selection: One DEV question per question_type: minimum SHA256('memeval_upstream_parity_sanity_v1:' + question_id) within each category.
upstream_parity_sanity_track.reader_controls: All included systems use gpt-4.1 under their pinned upstream prompts/settings; gpt-4o remains the separate judge. Do not compare this track's scores as though it were Main Track.

memory_system.definition: The system under comparison: ingestion/materialization, storage, revision policy, scope, retrieval, and context projection. It is not the reader, embedding provider, or judge.
memory_system.control: Capture all system-specific prompts, model calls, configurations, and outputs. No hidden/proprietary model advantage or unlogged call.

embedding_model.pricing_basis: Input tokens only; record API usage receipts per system.

judge_model.metric: LongMemEval native binary accuracy using the pinned MemEval judge prompt and implementation.

deterministic_metric.name: LongMemEval token F1
deterministic_metric.implementation: Pinned MemEval implementation; local deterministic calculation; no judge model call.

claim_guardrails: Main Track results use Qwen3-8B; never claim equivalence to or improvement over MemEval README gpt-4.1 scores.
The gpt-4.1 sanity subset is descriptive only and cannot replace the Qwen3-8B Main Track.
Reader, memory system, embedding model, and judge model must be reported in separate fields.
